name: Calcaneal Fracture
definition: Fracture of the calcaneus, often after high-energy axial loading but also as fragility or stress injury, with risk of subtalar dysfunction and soft-tissue complications.

redFlags.item: Associated spinal fracture after fall from height

core: Spine and other lower-limb injury screen

investigations.MRI: CT is key for intra-articular fracture planning; MRI is used more for occult/stress injury.
investigations.radiographs: Lateral/axial calcaneal radiographs are initial tests.

green: Immobilization and non/limited weight bearing according to pattern
amber: Operative versus nonoperative treatment depends on displacement, joint involvement, soft tissue and patient factors.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Pada-bhagna principles may complement recovery only after modern fracture management.

patientEducation.summary: Fracture of the calcaneus, often after high-energy axial loading but also as fragility or stress injury, with risk of subtalar dysfunction and soft-tissue complications.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise, rapidly escalating pain or other listed red flags.
